name: carrying-design-through
title_zh: 设计决策写进 spec 和 plan，不靠人肉同步
tagline_zh: 改一版设计，spec 的设计块、plan 的约束、每个任务的表格自动刷新。拆 spec 时连屏幕分配都替你算好。
tagline_en: Change a design once — spec blocks, plan constraints, per-task tables refresh automatically. Split specs and it.
desc_en: Use when a superpowers spec or plan is written or changed while docs/design/manifest.yaml exists — writes and refreshes the design block in the spec, the design header and global constraints in the plan, the per-task design tables, and the screen allocation when a spec is split. Invoked by the mockingbird PostToolUse hook (advisory) or the /design-spec, /design-sync and /design-split commands.
why_zh: 它把设计当一等公民：spec 和 plan 里的设计信息不是散落的文字，而是有结构的块。改一处。
why_en: Treats design as a first-class citizen: structured blocks, not scattered prose. Change once, the hook propagates to every.
limit_zh: 只认 superpowers 格式的 spec/plan（含 manifest.yaml）。若你的文档结构不合规。
limit_en: Only works with superpowers-format specs/plans (manifest.yaml present). Won't touch files outside its /design-spec, /design-sync, /design-split.
title_en: Design decisions written into spec & plan, no manual sync
